cases.name: 2022 AIIMS New Delhi Hospital Ransomware Infiltration
cases.examiner: Special Cyber Forensic Examiner (IFSO Special Cell)
cases.agency: Delhi Police Special Cell (IFSO) · CERT-In · National Cyber Security Coordinator
cases.jurisdiction: Ansari Nagar, New Delhi · National Critical Health Infrastructure
cases.notes: Ransomware encrypted 5 main physical database clusters containing millions of outpatient records and VVIP healthcare archives. Digital forensics recovered intact VSS shadow copies, extracted malware C2 beacon signatures from corrupted registry hives, and isolated the unauthorized pivot through a remote desktop terminal. All clinical patient databases were completely restored without paying extortion ransom.
cases.verdict: SOLVED & RESTORED — ZERO RANSOM PAID & DIGITAL ATTACK SURFACES HARDENED
cases.technique: Ransomware Extension Triage, Memory Volatility & Firewall Trajectory Scans
cases.scope: 5 Main Physical Servers & 40+ Virtual Database Endpoints (200TB)

evidence.notes: Forensic bitstream image of primary patient EHR database partition S01
Perimeter FortiGate firewall ingress/egress network packet captures with C2 beaconing
Volatile RAM memory capture containing decrypted ransomware key fragments in heap

cases.name: 2018 Cosmos Bank ₹94 Crore Malware & ATM Cyber Heist
cases.examiner: Cyber Crime Inspector (Maharashtra Cyber Crime Branch)
cases.agency: Maharashtra Cyber Police · Pune Cyber Cell · Interpol Digital Command
cases.jurisdiction: Pune Head Office & International ATM Switches (28 Nations)
cases.notes: Hackers deployed custom malware to clone the bank's ATM authorization switch server and generated counterfeit clone cards across 28 countries, followed by unauthorized SWIFT transfer requests to Hong Kong. Forensic extraction of Windows Event Logs, memory captures, and proxy PCAP packets identified rogue proxy servers in Canada and malware payload artifacts, recovering ₹13.93 crore and indicting global cyber cartel operatives under Section 65B and 43/66 of the IT Act.
cases.verdict: SOLVED & INDICTED — MALWARE REVERSED & CARTEL NETWORK CONVICTED
cases.technique: Malware Reverse Engineering & SWIFT/ATM Switch Packet Carving

evidence.notes: Byte-for-byte image of compromised ATM proxy switch server running malicious service
Cryptographically authenticated SWIFT MT103 financial messaging audit logs

cases.name: 2019 Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant (KKNPP) Cyber Infiltration
cases.agency: National Cyber Security Coordinator · NPCIL Forensic Audit Team · CERT-In
cases.notes: Dtrack spyware was detected within administrative domain controller endpoints of India's largest nuclear plant. Digital forensic disk triage revealed credentials dumped using Mimikatz variants. Critical operational reactor control systems were verified as completely air-gapped and unharmed, preserving national critical infrastructure with cryptographic hash verification.
cases.verdict: SOLVED & NEUTRALIZED — AIR-GAP CONFIRMED & MALWARE FOOTPRINT QUARANTINED
cases.technique: Dtrack Spyware Endpoint Artifact Extraction & Air-Gap Verification
cases.scope: Administrative Local Area Network Domain Controller & Workstations

evidence.notes: Forensic disk clone containing Dtrack Trojan binary artifact (0x00000001 NAL/PE signature)

cases.name: 2023 Mumbai ₹58 Crore High-Frequency Stock Broker SIM-Swap Fraud
cases.agency: Mumbai Police Cyber Cell (South Region) · Telecom Security Directorate
cases.jurisdiction: Nariman Point, Mumbai & NCR Telecom Nodes
cases.notes: Cyber syndicates executed fraudulent SIM-swap requests late Friday evening to intercept banking OTPs and siphon investments. Digital forensic examiners reconstructed an unbroken second-by-second timeline reconciling telecom Home Location Register (HLR) switch logs with bank API timestamps, freezing illicit mule accounts within hours and convicting 9 cross-state conspirators.
cases.verdict: SOLVED & RECOVERED — 9 CONSPIRATORS ARRESTED & ₹52 CRORE FROZEN
cases.technique: Cellular HLR/CDR Timeline Synchronization & IP Geo-Routing Forensics
cases.scope: 4 Telecom Retail SIM Nodes & Core Banking Multi-Factor Gateway Logs

evidence.notes: Forensically validated HLR activation records demonstrating fraudulent duplicate IMSI issuance
